arguments.result: Created PRD-1 (artifact id: 1) with 8 functional requirements (FR-1 through FR-8), 8 non-functional requirements (NFR-1 through NFR-8), and 8 business rules (RULE-1 through RULE-8). All 24 child artifacts have been registered with derived_from traces to PRD-1. The PRD addresses the Hex Button Autism UI Component Library based on the accepted discovery document, covering configurable reduced motion, visual clarity adjustments, focus indicators, sensory feedback, keyboard navigation, screen reader optimization, component configuration, and NPM package distribution. Non-functional requirements include performance targets (p99 < 100ms interaction latency, FCP < 1.5s), accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 AAA, screen reader compatibility), package size limits, TypeScript strict mode, test coverage, and React version compatibility.
